name: Dominique Tipper
biography: Dominique Jade Tipper is a British actress, dancer, and singer-songwriter. She rose to prominence in her role as Naomi Nagata, the engineer in the sci-fi series The Expanse. In 2022, she had a recurring role in the Norwegian miniseries Headhunters, based on the famous Jo Nesbø novel.
